name: picket-browser-extension
description: Picket block page and temporary allows for Brave and Firefox (browser-extension.md).

scripts.typecheck: node node_modules/typescript-native/bin/tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && node node_modules/typescript-native/bin/tsc -p test/tsconfig.json --noEmit && node node_modules/typescript-native/bin/tsc -p tsconfig.node.json --noEmit
scripts.lint: npm run typecheck && eslint --max-warnings 0 . && npm run lint:firefox
scripts.test:browser:slow: node scripts/build.mjs && PICKET_BROWSER_SLOW=1 PICKET_BROWSER_LOADS=300 playwright test --grep "@slow|silently dropped|appears for every blocked page load"
